posts.title: Pihole in HA mode
posts.description: Pihole is the central point of resolving internal and external domains in my homelab. Running this on only one device is a classical SPOF so I run two separate instances on two physical devices in HA mode. In my homelab I decided to use two spare Raspberry Pis doing all DNS resolving. posts.title: Deploy your static site with curl
posts.description: Long time I somehow struggled what would be the best way to deploy my static site. Hosting provider offer either FTP or a REST API to push your files onto. Depending on 3rd-party tools was not really an option. I use Bunny.net for hosting my page. They offer either FTP or a REST API.
